It’s not too late, baby, for one more: ‘Beautiful’ at Drury Lane Oakbrook Reviews Feb 11 Written by Patrick O'Brien Drury Lane’s go at “ Beautiful ” is the latest production of the Carole King bio-musical in Chicagoland after both Marriott and Paramount had their turn.
Packed with great music from start to finish, “Beautiful: The Carole King Musical” is a lovely celebration of one of the most successful songwriters in American history.
